title: The start of a day is in the offset of the device that wrote the record: a moved receipt and a typed spend with no time (decision X9, confirm_review_1 item 9)
story: Mako's phone is in Japan (+09:00). A 38.31 copy last saved Tue 24 Nov 2026 at 08:00 +09:00 is moved: its bank figure of 300,000 was typed on Sun 22 Nov at 07:00 +09:00, so the bank opens then. A moved receipt of 5,000 dated 22 Nov has no time: it is told at the start of 22 Nov in the moving device's offset, so it is inside the 07:00 figure [J2, X9]. On the new app the person logs a 2,000 spend dated 22 Nov with no time (start of its day, on this device: inside the figure) and a 1,000 spend told at 08:00 with no offset of its own (08:00 on this device, +09:00: after the figure). Before X9 a day with no time started at midnight UTC (09:00 in Japan), after the 07:00 figure, and a time with no offset was read as UTC. Every amount is made up.

events.note: moved receipt, no time: the start of 22 Nov in +09:00
typed with a date only: the start of 22 Nov on this device

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 300,000 (figure Sun 22 Nov 07:00 +09:00; the moved 5,000 and the typed 2,000 with no time are inside it) - 1,000 (spend 08:00 on this device, after the figure) = 299,000
asks.note: Before X9: 292,000 (each of the three taken off again).
